svg.title: Find Foundry credentials for MSS and MCS-COP
svg.desc: Illustrated map showing an administrator-approved HTTPS base URL, development token creation in Account Settings Tokens, dataset RID and branch in About, and TLS CA profile chosen with the operator. Connected status alone is not proof of transfer readiness.
svg.text: DATA MOVER · MSS + MCS-COP · FOUNDRY
Find the connection details
Use the endpoint, identity and dataset approved for each provider.
API endpoint
Confirm the HTTPS API base with your MSS or MCS-COP administrator.
https://<your-approved-foundry-host>
No dataset page or /api/v2 suffix
Development API token
Open in the intended Foundry environment:
Account → Settings → Tokens
Create token
Name + description + expiry → Generate
Copy once. Paste only the token value.
Palantir specifies OAuth2 for production applications.
This app does not acquire or refresh OAuth tokens.
Dataset RID + branch
DATASET → ABOUT → SEE MORE
RID
ri.foundry.main.dataset.<dataset-id>
Branch
Copy the exact existing branch name
Use the copy control for the complete RID.
Details → Files shows the dataset's files.
Default branch is master; confirm it for your dataset.
The main segment in a RID is not the selected branch.
IN DATA MOVER · CONNECTIONS → CREDENTIALS
Choose the MSS or MCS-COP card. TLS CA profile: system by default, or nipr as directed by the operator.
Save and test changes → Status. Read the full branch / file-count message.
Without a default dataset RID, access stays Untested. Connected alone does not prove transfer readiness.
Illustration · reviewed October 22, 2026 · vendor screenshots and source links are in the guide.
